sources.name: Current Liquor Authority Active Licenses
sources.filter: description IN ('Liquor Store','Wine Store') AND county in 5 NYC boroughs

sources.name: Current Liquor Authority Active Licenses
sources.filter: description IN ('Grocery Store','Drug Store') AND county in 5 NYC boroughs

sources.name: Current OCM Licenses
sources.agency: New York State Office of Cannabis Management
sources.filter: license_type in adult-use retail/microbusiness/RO dispensary types AND license_status='Active' AND county in 5 NYC boroughs

sources.name: Legally Operating Businesses
sources.agency: NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
sources.filter: business_category IN ('Tobacco Retail Dealer','Electronic Cigarette Dealer') AND license_status in ('Active','Ready for Renewal')

limitations: A current license is not the same as a currently operating business. Some licensees close, move, or sell without notifying the regulator.
Illegal/unlicensed cannabis or smoke shops are not in any of these datasets.
Licensees can hold multiple license types at one address (e.g., a bodega may appear as both a liquor seller and a tobacco dealer at the same address).
OCM addresses are geocoded via NYC DCP GeoSearch. A small share of records fail to geocode; those are excluded from the map but kept in the CSV.
